exposure: platelet indices (e.g., Platelet distribution width - PDW)
cohort: The study involved 150 preterm neonates (<= 34 weeks gestational age) admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit.
finding: Platelet distribution width (PDW) and clinical Kindler score were significantly higher and independent predictors of hsPDA, which in turn was associated with longer hospitalization, higher respiratory complications, and increased mortality rates.
cross-section timing: Data collection for platelet parameters and C-reactive protein was performed on the first day of life.
